name: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya
layout: Grand Prix circuit (2023+, no chicane, Turns 13-14 fast)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap highway=raceway ways (2023+ final sector via the fast Turns 13-14, ways 1560896061/893732520 "AZ"), finish line from OSM node 14202158171; Overpass API, (c) OSM contributors ODbL
sources.width: Measured: white edge-line pairs on perpendicular profiles every 6 m in IGN PNOA orthophoto (https://www.ign.es/wms-inspire/pnoa-ma, OI.OrthoimageCoverage), Viterbi-linked, median/smoothed; gaps interpolated
sources.elevation: ICGC MET 2 m (LiDAR terrain model of Catalonia, vertical error ~0.15 m) via WMS GetFeatureInfo https://geoserveis.icgc.cat/serveis/catalunya/icgc_mdt2m/wms (layer MET2m); used instead of CNIG MDT02 (no open WCS; IDEE WCS only 5 m)
sources.camber: Crossfall from ICGC MET 2 m samples at both track edges (1.2 m inset), trackkit.profile_from_samples
sources.pit: OSM ways 33742214 (Entrada al Pit Lane), 178416729 (Pit Lane), 178416733 (Sortida del Pit Lane)
sources.trim: Mix of long fast corners (T3, T9) and slow final sector: medium-high downforce, classic aero benchmark
sources.pitLimit: FIA F1 pit lane speed limit 80 km/h (2026 Barcelona-Catalunya GP event notes)
sources.pitLoss: About 22 s: 2026 F1 pit stop summary pit-lane times ~21.8-22.5 s for normal stops (formula1.com results), consistent with published ~22 s
sources.raceLaps: 2026 Barcelona-Catalunya GP 66 laps (not a sprint weekend)

notes: Clockwise. Station 0 on the finish/control line (OSM raceway=finish node on the main straight; the MotoGP finish line further back is not used). 2023+ layout without the Turn 14-15 chicane; 14 turns.
